Package com.privatechain.crypto

Class ECKeyPair

java.lang.Object
com.privatechain.crypto.ECKeyPair
public final class ECKeyPair extends Object
Immutable record holding an elliptic-curve key pair generated on the secp256k1 curve.

Instances are created exclusively by KeyPairGenerator.generateECKeyPair() or reconstructed from a hex-encoded private key via KeyPairGenerator.fromPrivateKeyHex(String). Consumer code should treat this object as an opaque credential holder and never log, serialize, or transmit it in plain form.

Security invariants

  • toString() never reveals the private key (NFR-SEC-01). The private-key field is rendered as [REDACTED].
  • getPrivateKeyHex() exists for legitimate export flows (e.g., keystore serialisation) but callers must protect the returned value.

 ECKeyPair keyPair = KeyPairGenerator.generateECKeyPair();
 String     pubHex  = keyPair.getPublicKeyHex();   // safe to share
 String     privHex = keyPair.getPrivateKeyHex();  // handle with care
Since:
1.0.0

  • Method Details

    • getPublicKey

      public PublicKey getPublicKey()
      Returns the JCA PublicKey for this key pair.

      The public key may be shared freely; it is used to verify ECDSA signatures and to derive blockchain addresses.

      Returns:
      non-null public key

    • getPublicKeyHex

      public String getPublicKeyHex()
      Returns the uncompressed, DER-encoded public key as a lowercase hex string.

      The hex representation is the canonical form used in peer announcements and address derivation.

      Returns:
      130-character (65-byte, uncompressed point) hex string

    • getPrivateKeyHex

      public String getPrivateKeyHex()
      Returns the PKCS#8-encoded private key as a lowercase hex string.

      Warning: this value is a secret. The caller is responsible for zeroing the returned String from memory after use where possible. Only invoke this method in trusted, controlled code paths such as keystore encryption.

      Returns:
      hex-encoded private key bytes

    • toString

      public String toString()
      Returns a safe, human-readable summary of this key pair.

      The private key is never included in the output (NFR-SEC-01). The public key is truncated to its first 16 hex characters to keep log lines concise.

      Overrides:
      toString in class Object
      Returns:
